status: All eight candidates implemented and tried. Independent full-checkpoint/lifecycle, existing architecture, fixed shared-engine and repository audit gates pass. CPU remains selected; performance outcomes recorded without individual attribution.

items.title: Batched greedy draft verification
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Evaluate_Greedy_Batch preserves complete logit rows and returns lowest-ID ties with one excluded token. Lookup verification uses it only with no other sampling transforms; ordinary sampling remains the fallback.

items.title: Output row tile epilogue
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Complete the bias/softcap/greedy epilogue in 128-row output tiles around existing native packed products. The original 18118 kernel literals and assembly parent remain unchanged.

items.title: Route-aware CPU dispatch
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Choose chunk sizes from each actual expert token count and use a bounded existing worker team. Router outputs and numerical accumulation order remain unchanged.

items.title: Cached metadata eviction scores
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Compute each expert/arm eviction priority at most once per current logical visit before workers borrow metadata views.

items.title: Elastic bounded metadata shares
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Allow loop layers to borrow unused metadata space, reserving a half-share floor and limiting any one layer to two equal shares within the unchanged 128 MiB global bound.

items.title: Repeated routing work plans
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Retain exact routing bucket/chunk/order descriptors for batches up to 16 tokens. Reuse requires identical physical-layer routed expert assignments and count. Router math and activations are always recomputed; reset may retain harmless descriptors and close frees them.

items.title: GPU packed input reuse
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: Reuse native GPU activation packing only across adjacent compatible products with the same source, offset, columns and packing family. Other products retain the existing 4 MiB scratch barriers.

items.title: Batched ordered GPU expert aggregation
items.status: implemented and correctness-qualified; aggregate performance evaluation only
items.scope: GPU weighted aggregation supports 2..128 tokens with a common ordered resident expert set and token-specific shares. Routing order and separate binary32 multiply/add are preserved. Other layouts retain the existing gathered resident/CPU path and host sum.
